issues.description: The Problem Statement and the template expect/getAllPersons to work with a List<Person>, but the solution changes the service method to return a Set<Person>. Additionally, the solution's PersonResource declares ResponseEntity<List<Person>> but forwards the Set returned by PersonService directly. This creates a type mismatch (List vs Set) that will cause compilation errors in the server code and confusion for students about the expected return type for getAllPersons.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the PersonService.getAllPersons method return the same collection type expected by the API and client (List<Person>) — e.g., sort into a List<Person> and return an unmodifiable List. Alternatively, change PersonResource's and client code's signatures to consistently use Set<Person>. Prefer returning List<Person> to match the template, the problem description, and the client-side ParameterizedTypeReference<List<Person>>.
